title: Security review
description: A review that finds real exposure and proves the mitigations, without printing a secret or hiding a finding to get a green check.

criteria.title: No secrets exposed
criteria.ask: Source, history, logs, build output, client bundles, CI variables: any credential anywhere? Rotated if it was?
criteria.evidence: The scan performed and its result. Never include the secret value itself.

criteria.title: Untrusted input is handled
criteria.ask: SQL, shell, path, template, HTML and deserialization sinks: is every external value validated or escaped for its sink?
criteria.evidence: The sinks found and how each is protected.

criteria.title: Authentication and authorization
criteria.ask: Can a user reach another user's data, or an admin action, by changing an id or a request?
criteria.evidence: The access paths tried and the result.

criteria.title: Dependencies are healthy
criteria.ask: Known vulnerabilities by severity and reachability, pinned versions, install scripts reviewed?
criteria.evidence: The audit output and decisions on each high or critical finding.

criteria.title: Hardened configuration
criteria.ask: Headers, CORS, cookies, debug flags, default credentials, error pages?

criteria.title: Personal data minimized
criteria.ask: What personal data is collected, where does it go, how long does it stay, is it in the logs?
criteria.evidence: A data inventory: each item collected, where it is stored, who can read it and when it is deleted.

criteria.title: Findings reported plainly
criteria.ask: Is every finding listed with severity, not downgraded to pass, and is what was not tested stated?
criteria.evidence: The findings table and the untested areas.
